public_rationale: The claim is read as saying that paying demand for generative AI was too small to cover its costs in 2024. He says the tools have some product-market fit. The 2024 evidence fits this reading. In September 2024, CNBC confirmed that OpenAI expected about a $5 billion loss on $3.7 billion of revenue that year. The same report said OpenAI was raising a new funding round (e2). In June 2024, a Sequoia Capital analysis assumed generous new AI revenue at large tech firms. It still estimated that the gap between AI revenue and what the infrastructure spending required had grown from $125 billion to $500 billion (e1). In August 2024, OpenAI said ChatGPT had more than 200 million weekly active users, double the figure from the previous fall (e3). That shows real demand, but it does not show revenue covering costs. The result depends on reading 'scale necessary to support its existence' as revenue covering costs.
limitations: The claim gives no threshold, so the result depends on the revenue-covers-costs reading.
OpenAI's 2024 figures were projections reported from company documents, not audited results.
The Sequoia gap is an investor's estimate built on stated assumptions, not measured data.
The evidence covers OpenAI and an industry estimate. It does not include revenue and cost figures for other generative AI firms.
Revenue changes after 2024 fall outside the period tested.

our_interpretation: He concedes some product-market fit exists. The plain reading is that, at the time, paying demand for generative AI was too small to cover the cost of building and running it, so the leading firms depended on outside capital.
Period: no period is named beyond 'at this time'. Calendar 2024 is used because the most recent public estimates before the post (July 2024) covered that year.
criteria.support_condition: 2024 evidence shows generative AI revenue well below the cost of building and running the models, with leading firms losing large sums and an industry-wide gap between spending and revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: 2024 evidence shows generative AI revenue covering its costs at leading firms, or industry revenue in line with spending.
